title: Relationship Desk Card: Lessee Deduction from a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Re-opened Installment Charge
content:
**Relationship desk card — retail customers who also lease from Kestrel.** This deduction applies to the late charge on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract installment that a returned payment re-opened, and it reads the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease.

**Rule.** When the customer holds an active Kestrel lease (a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease in active status) and the customer's Kestrel lease ledger shows at least 12 lease payments and no lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, 3.00 dollars are deducted from the re-opened installment late charge; when the customer holds an active Kestrel lease and the lease ledger shows no more than one lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met, 1.50 dollars are deducted; in every other case nothing is deducted.

The deduction is taken from the re-opened installment late charge once the late-charge cap has been applied, and the charge after the deduction is never below zero.

## Condition table

| Active Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease | Lease payments, last 12 calendar months | Lease late charges, last 12 calendar months | Deducted |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | none | 3.00 dollars |
| yes | 12 or more | one | 1.50 dollars |
| yes | fewer than 12 | none or one | 1.50 dollars |
| yes | any | two or more | nothing |
| no | any | any | nothing |

**Records read.** The lease payment and lease late charge entries on the customer's Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease ledger, counted by their dates. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A lessee whose active lease shows 12 lease payments and no lease late charge in the last 12 calendar months: 3.00 dollars come off. A capped charge of 2.40 dollars would fall to zero, not below.
- A lessee whose active lease shows 9 lease payments and one lease late charge: 1.50 dollars come off.
- A customer whose lease has ended and is no longer active: nothing comes off, whatever its ledger shows.
